name: VGG Synthetic Cells
notes: Classical synthetic cell-counting benchmark. AcademicTorrents hosts a mirror but is not treated as the official homepage.

name: UCF_CC_50
notes: Extremely dense still-image benchmark introduced with the CVPR 2013 paper; no reliable first-party dataset homepage was confirmed.

name: CVPPP Leaf Counting Challenge
size: 1,311 images;about 18,016 leaf instances across commonly aggregated releases
notes: A1-A5 subsets differ in species acquisition and annotation availability; retain subset identity.

name: TRANCOS
notes: Static traffic-camera images; not a line-crossing or traffic-flow dataset.

name: WorldExpo'10
notes: Surveillance-video frames normally evaluated independently; no reliable current first-party download entry was confirmed.

name: COWC
notes: Cars Overhead With Context; source imagery and negative examples may have source-specific terms.

name: Penguin Counting Dataset
notes: Released with Counting in the Wild; annotations originate from Penguin Watch volunteers; a stable direct dataset archive was not confirmed.

name: ShanghaiTech
notes: Part A has 482 images and Part B has 716 images. Public Kaggle copies are mirrors and are intentionally not recorded as the official homepage.

name: CARPK
notes: Parking-lot car counting benchmark; official archive is distributed jointly with PUCPR+.

name: MoNuSeg
notes: 30 training and 14 test images; counting is derived from exhaustive masks.

name: MTC
notes: Official repository states six maize cultivars and four experimental fields.

name: PUCPR+
notes: Distinct dataset from CARPK despite the combined download archive; total instance count remains unverified.

name: UCF-QNRF
license: research access terms; exact license unknown
notes: Official UCF page confirms 1,201 training and 334 test images.

name: FDST
notes: Collected from 13 scenes with temporal sequences.

name: GCC
annotations: head points;density/count metadata;scene and camera attributes
notes: Synthetic GTA-V-based crowd dataset; should be marked synthetic in comparisons.

name: SKU-110K
categories: 1 generic SKU-object target in standard benchmark
notes: Not a dedicated industrial-parts dataset; retained only as an adjacent dense repetitive-object benchmark.

name: TallyQA
tasks: MLLM/VQA counting;simple and complex counting questions
license: Apache-2.0 for released QA metadata/code; source images retain COCO/Visual Genome terms
notes: Includes 211,430 simple and 76,477 complex counting questions.

name: BCData
notes: Dedicated large-scale cell detection and counting dataset.

name: JHU-CROWD++
annotations: head points;approximate boxes;occlusion;blur;weather and illumination attributes
notes: Official author repository confirms 4,372 images and about 1.51M dot annotations.

name: MoNuSAC
notes: Multi-organ and multi-class; retain patient grouping and source splits.

name: NWPU-Crowd
notes: Official project confirms point and box labels and 351 negative images.

name: AGAR
notes: Contains real and synthetic agar-plate images. OpenDataLab is a mirror and is intentionally not recorded as the official homepage.

name: DroneCrowd
size: 112 clips;33,600 HD frames;4.8M head annotations;20,800 trajectories
notes: Counting localization and tracking are explicit benchmark tasks. OpenDataLab hosts a mirror but is not recorded as the official homepage.

name: FSC-147
annotations: center points;3 exemplar boxes per image;counts
notes: Canonical few-shot class-agnostic benchmark; train validation and test categories are disjoint.

name: GWHD 2021
notes: Expanded 2021 release; preserve acquisition-domain identifiers.

name: LIVECell
notes: Originally an instance-segmentation dataset; counting uses exhaustive instances and should be labelled as a converted benchmark.

name: Lizard
notes: Colonic histology benchmark; counting is obtained from exhaustive nuclei instances.

name: NuCLS
notes: The official class ontology is richer than a cell/non-cell split; consolidated category count remains unverified.

name: CoNIC
notes: Counting is derivable from exhaustive class-labelled instances.

name: FSCD-147
size: 6,135 images; exhaustive boxes added for validation and test
annotations: points;three exemplar boxes;target bounding boxes on validation/test;counts
notes: Detection extension of FSC-147; distinct from the LVIS-derived FSCD-LVIS dataset.

name: FSCD-LVIS
tasks: few-shot object counting and detection;class-agnostic counting
license: inherits LVIS/source-image restrictions; exact derived-data license unknown
notes: Distinct from FSCD-147; this is the larger-vocabulary LVIS-derived benchmark.

name: CountBench
notes: Curated from LAION-400M URLs; some URLs are now inaccessible and no stable first-party image archive was confirmed.

name: FSC-147-D
notes: CounTX corrects ambiguous class names and converts them to natural-language responses specifying what to count.

name: IOCfish5K
notes: Dedicated dense and visually indiscernible fish-counting benchmark; no reliable separate first-party download page was confirmed.

name: CountBenchQA
size: 491 currently packaged images from the original 540 CountBench entries
license: Apache-2.0 for Google code/metadata; image rights remain source-dependent
notes: VQA reformulation of CountBench; distinguish 491 currently accessible images from 540 original records.

name: MCAC
notes: Each image contains 1-4 categories; train/validation/test categories are disjoint; MCAC-M1 is the single-class subset.

name: NWPU-MOC
notes: Official repository confirms RGB/IR inputs and 14 category folders; total image and instance counts remain unverified.

name: PixMo-Count
size: 36,916 train records;540 validation;540 test;URLs may repeat
notes: Validation and test are human verified and cover counts 2-10; images are referenced by URLs.

name: UpCount
notes: Official Zenodo image archive is available; exact sample and annotation totals remain unverified.

name: 3D Counting Dataset
size: 400,000 synthetic images from 14,000 scenes;45 real scenes
notes: Includes 3DC-Synthetic and 3DC-Real; counts visible and hidden objects in irregular stacks.

name: CAPTURe
modality: synthetic and real image with question
size: 2,212 released records across real and synthetic splits
notes: Released-record count verified through the Hugging Face dataset server; benchmark includes CAPTURe-Synthetic and CAPTURe-Real.

name: CARPK-OCC
size: derived from CARPK; exact released size unknown
annotations: original boxes/counts plus synthetic occluders and occlusion metadata
notes: CountOCC evaluation variant; keep separate from the unmodified CARPK benchmark.

name: CG-AV-Counting
notes: Supports black-box answer evaluation and white-box clue-grounded evaluation.

name: CountQA
size: 1,001 released image records; over 1,500 QA pairs
notes: Paper reports over 1,500 QA pairs; current official package exposes 1,001 rows, so both quantities are retained.

name: DroneBird
notes: Introduced by E-MAC; split uses 40 clips of 500 frames and 10 validation clips of 150 frames.

name: FSC-147-OCC
size: derived from FSC-147; exact released size unknown
annotations: original points/counts plus synthetic occluders and occlusion metadata
notes: CountOCC evaluation variant; no stable public release link or exact generated-corpus size was confirmed.

name: LOCO
notes: Official paper/repository confirms industrial, agricultural, and daily-life domains; numeric scale and dataset license were not confirmed.

name: MovingDroneCrowd
notes: Captured by fast-moving drones; scene-level 70/10/20 train/validation/test split.

name: OmniCount-191
notes: Supports several target categories per image.

name: PairTally
tasks: fine-grained selective counting;intent-driven counting;MLLM and CAC evaluation
annotations: category-specific counts;fine-grained positive/negative prompts;paired distractor categories
notes: Each image contains two object categories; includes inter-category and visually similar intra-category settings.

name: PrACo
size: derived test suite over FSC-147; no independent image corpus
annotations: positive/negative prompts; positive-label and negative-label tests; prompt-aware metrics
notes: Benchmark protocol rather than a standalone image dataset; keep separate from ordinary MAE/RMSE rankings.

name: CLOC
annotations: unified points;source-dependent boxes/masks/polygons before conversion;text queries
license: inherits all upstream licenses; no single image license
notes: Complete images cannot be redistributed as one archive; annotations and rebuild instructions are released.

name: EC-Bench
notes: Median video duration 47 minutes; average about 57 minutes; includes six balanced reasoning categories.

name: GROC
notes: Designed for adverse earth-observation conditions; category count and a first-party download page were not stated on the CVF paper page.

name: HoloCount
tasks: holistic visual counting;semantic and analytical reasoning;robustness testing
notes: Official project reports 20 fine-grained subsets and a three-level taxonomy.

name: KubriCount
notes: Official project confirms the task and release; numeric scale and license remain unverified.

name: MixCount
tasks: mixed-object counting;open-vocabulary counting;synthetic training and evaluation
notes: Official dataset card reports 58K scenes, 1,522 classes, dense pixel-perfect labels, and mixed-object prompts.

name: MUCCA
notes: Paper confirms the new multi-category dataset; size and class-per-image range are reported in the paper, but a stable public download entry was not confirmed.

name: OCCAM Synthetic Multi-Class
notes: Paper announces a synthetic multi-class dataset; public release and exact scale were not confirmed.

name: PrACo++
size: evaluation suite over existing counting datasets plus MUCCA
notes: Protocol suite; its new standalone real-image dataset is recorded separately as MUCCA.

name: SVCBench
tasks: streaming video counting;spatial-temporal state maintenance;MLLM evaluation
notes: Official paper and project confirm the benchmark; numeric corpus scale was not verified in this pass.

name: TPC-268
notes: Spans canopy-scale remote sensing through tissue-level microscopy, including Plantae and Fungi.

name: UNICBench
size: 5,300 images / 5,508 image QA;872 documents / 5,888 text QA;2,069 audio clips / 2,905 audio QA
annotations: questions;numeric answers;evidence-first ground truth;difficulty and capability tags
notes: Three-level Pattern/Semantic/Reasoning taxonomy with modality-specific matching rules.

name: VideoCount
tasks: open-world video object counting;unique-instance counting;text/exemplar prompting;tracking
annotations: track identities;instance masks/boxes;video-level unique counts;text and visual prompts
notes: Built from TAO MOT20 penguin and X-ray metal-alloy videos; numeric clip and category totals remain unverified.
